1. [blocking][issue-impact] Retried manual attestations can make latest-run disagree with readiness. The mutation context retains its sampled timestamp across retries (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2315`, `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:1079`); a retry that publishes after another attestation can therefore write the current issue status with an older `started_at`. Latest-run selects the greatest timestamp (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1366`), while readiness selects the last-published `gates_status` (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1422`). Opposing attestations can consequently report different statuses, violating REQ-03.
